article.title: About SaxonC
article.p: SaxonC is a version of Saxon developed by compiling the Java source code to native executables that run on the C/C++ platform (C++14 minimum), with extensions for PHP and Python. All features of Saxon have been ported, other than those (such as collations) that are necessarily platform dependent. In particular, SaxonC provides processing in XSLT, XQuery and XPath, and Schema validation. It therefore makes these processing capabilities available to a plethora of other languages that are strongly coupled to C/C++ such as PHP, Perl, Python, and Ruby. (For instance, saxon-node uses SaxonC to create an interface with Node.js.)

SaxonC 12 is built from the SaxonJ 12 Java product using GraalVM Native Image (GraalVM for JDK 21 Community 21.0.2). The APIs support the current W3C Recommendations: XSLT 3.0, XQuery 3.1, XPath 3.1 and Schema Validation 1.0/1.1. See the main Saxon 12 documentation Standards conformance section for full details.

SaxonC is released in three separate editions, as on the Java platform: the commercial products Enterprise Edition (SaxonC-EE) and Professional Edition (SaxonC-PE), and the opensource product Home Edition (SaxonC-HE). See the feature matrix to compare the features of the HE, PE and EE products.
Versions are available for the following platforms: Linux 64-bit, Mac OS (AArch64 and Intel x86_64), and Windows 64-bit.
article.aside: This documentation contains information specific to SaxonC, including details about how to install the products and get started using them, and the full API documentation for C/C++, Python and PHP. Please also see the main Saxon 12 documentation for further information on Saxon generally. A number of direct links are provided from this documentation to specific sections of the main documentation, but there is plenty more which will be relevant to SaxonC users. In particular, from Saxon 12.4 the main documentation has been updated to provide more details relevant for the C/C++, PHP and Python platforms where this differs to Saxon on the Java and C# platforms.

section.title: Technical details
section.p: SaxonC is built by compiling the Java code of Saxon 12 using GraalVM Native Image (GraalVM for JDK 21 Community 21.0.2). This generates platform specific machine code, which we interface with C/C++ using the Native Image C API.

Embedded systems: It is also possible to build SaxonC for embedded systems, for example on a Linux/ARM System. If such a build is required please contact Saxonica to discuss further: support@saxonica.com.
The PHP interface is in the form of a C/C++ PHP extension to SaxonC created using the Zend module API. Supports PHP8.
The Python interface is in the form of a Cython module interfaced with the C/C++ SaxonC API. Currently supports Python3.
We currently use the Xerces XML parser which is also compiled using GraalVM. There are currently no links to libxml.

section.title: Technical support
section.p: Please use the help forums and bug trackers for SaxonC at saxonica.plan.io if you need help or advice. Or send email to support@saxonica.com.
For further details see the main Saxon 12 documentation section Technical support.
